thread:
Alyssa: Quick sync — launching the "Tugboat" co-sell pilot with NorthCloud (SI) next quarter. Need to lock lead-ownership rules and announcement guardrails.

Matt S: +1. Can we pick a default claim window so leads don’t sit? I vote 48h.

Jordan: I’d prefer 72h unless a demo is pre-booked. Gives field time to prep and avoid churn.

Tasha: For named accounts: field owns initial outreach. For inbound SI-sourced leads, SI owns until an SDR/AE touches the lead. If AE replies, ownership transfers.

Sam E: For account mapping, propose a minimal CSV schema we can auto-ingest: 
```
account_alias,account_id,owner,source,claim_deadline_iso,demo_scheduled
acme-inc,AC-123,Tasha,SI,2026-05-02T17:00Z,true
```
We can validate `claim_deadline_iso` server-side.

Alyssa: Good. Also need roles for joint announcements and marketplace listings: who drafts, approval SLAs, and embargo windows.

Matt S: Proposal: Redwood drafts announcement copy, SI gets 3 business days to review and request redlines. SI is responsible for creating the marketplace listing under the co-sell SKU; Redwood provides the artifact bundle (logos, sample usage, performance blurb).

Jordan: Agree. Add a one-week embargo buffer for coordinated PR.

Tasha: I’ll route the rules-of-engagement doc to Legal for co-branded asset approvals.

Alyssa: Ops ask: set up a dedicated Slack channel and weekly triage. Can someone create #tugboat-partners and invite NorthCloud PMs?

Sam E: Done — created #tugboat-partners and invited the SI contacts. Also uploaded the initial email/handoff templates to the partner drive: https://drive.redwood/si/tugboat/templates (access: partners+redwood). @Matt S can you review the outreach copy?

deploy-bot: Meeting created: Tugboat partner triage — Wednesdays 09:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/evt/abcd

Matt S: Reviewed templates — small tweaks re: subject lines and CTA. Will PR to the shared doc today.

Jordan: We should add an auto-escalation rule: if no claim within the window, escalate to the assigned Redwood AE. Prevents leads from going cold.

Alyssa: Agreed. Default policy: claim_window = 72h, auto_escalate = true. Sam, can you add `auto_escalate` to the ingest schema so the workflow can flip?

Sam E: Will do. Adding `auto_escalate` (boolean) and `escalation_target` (email) fields. Example: `auto_escalate:true, escalation_target:ae@redwood.com`.

Tasha: Minor ops note: ensure demo env access tokens rotate and SI has a temporary demo key per account. Security wants TTL on partner keys.

Alyssa: Noted — Sam / Infra to own token TTL.

Alyssa: Next steps checklist I’ll put into a GH issue: finalize CSV schema, approve 72h claim window, create #tugboat-partners (done), invite SI PMs, add auto-escalation, upload final outreach templates, route ROE to Legal, and schedule the announcement timeline.

Jordan: lgtm.

Matt S: +1 :thumbsup:

Sam E: I’ll open the PR for the ingest and push the template updates this afternoon.

Tasha: I’ll follow up with Legal and Security on the co-branding and demo keys.

Alyssa: Thanks everyone — I’ll convert this thread into the GH issue and ping reviewers. Closing for now. :rocket:
